identity.fantasy: A heavy holy weapon fighter who spins Righteous Tempest through packs, builds radiant brands and judgments, and cashes them into large cleave.
identity.one_line: A heavy crusading attacker centered on Righteous Tempest, Holy Tempest, brands, judgments, and radiant weapon strikes. It offers strong cleave and a straightforward build-and-spend rhythm, with current builds particularly emphasizing AoE.

mechanics.core_loop: Use Righteous Tempest and weapon strikes to establish pressure, maintain Crusader's Brand and Judgment effects, trigger Holy Tempest and radiant echoes across packs, then align Titanfall or Scarlet Champion with durable targets.

modes.name: Scarlet Training
modes.structural_description: Level 30 PassiveCasting Argent Blade while Warrior of Dawn is active now transforms your next Chastise into Scarlet Hammer.Scarlet HammerDrop a scarlet hammer on an enemy for 155% Weapon Damage plus 35 as Holy Damage, causing the Templar's attacks to ignore 10% of their Armor and giving each auto attack a chance to heal the Templar for 2% of their maximum health for 30 seconds.

modes.name: Legacy of the Silver Hand
modes.structural_description: Casting Argent Blade or Scarlet Hammer now guarantees your next 2 instances of damage dealt by Scourgebane to critically strike.Increases the critical damage of Scourgebane by 15%.

mechanics.single_target: Build and spend through weapon strikes, brand, Judgment, and late Titan payoffs; current evidence is less detailed here than for AoE.
mechanics.aoe: Righteous Tempest, Whirling or Holy Tempest, Light's Echo, radiant strikes, and brand interactions make pack cleave the best-documented identity.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Divine Charge helps reconnect, while persistent brands and tempest coverage reduce some target-swap friction.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Plate durability, Light's Chosen, Scourge-defense tools, and general Templar utility create a forgiving melee shell.
mechanics.group_utility: Judgment, brands, Holy effects, and Templar blessings provide secondary party value.

failure_modes.text: Spending or spreading the holy setup on enemies that die before Tempest and brand payoffs land wastes the cleave window.
Movement or a target swap can interrupt the intended payoff: divine charge helps reconnect, while persistent brands and tempest coverage reduce some target-swap friction.

enjoy_if.text: You want an accessible heavy holy melee spec with satisfying pack cleave and room for brand and proc optimization.

You enjoy the spec's core cadence: use righteous tempest and weapon strikes to establish pressure, maintain crusader's brand and judgment effects, trigger holy tempest and radiant echoes across packs, then align titanfall or scarlet champion with durable targets.

avoid_if.text: You want a highly mobile duelist or require a fully verified current single-target guide.
You dislike the positioning or swap constraint that divine charge helps reconnect, while persistent brands and tempest coverage reduce some target-swap friction.

praise.theme: Recent new-player discussion and high Mythic representation support Crusader as a readable, popular holy cleave option.

frustrations.theme: Current written build guidance is unusually thin, and the strongest DPS signal carries a possible-bug warning.

contested.theme: Crusader is often called easy, but later brand, proc, and window layers make the optimized version more involved than its spinning core suggests.

gaps: The linked build video has not been verified against the snapshot.

claims.text: A July level-56 Templar discussion describes a dungeon sequence built around applying and spreading holy damage-over-time effects before using the cleave package; an August new-player thread also treats Crusader as one of the more approachable specs, though definitions of easy differ.
claims.notes: The detailed source is one leveling player's sequence, not an optimal guide.

claims.text: The current top Build Hub entry is explicitly AoE-focused but contains almost no written mechanical guidance and links an external video that has not been verified against the August snapshot.
claims.notes: The linked video is not accepted as verified evidence.

claims.text: The July compilation reports Crusader at 6,126 with a possible-bug warning, and the August Mythic inventory lists 291 records.
claims.notes: Possible bug, missing normalization, and high representation prevent ranking claims.

claims.text: Crusader's pack failure cost is mainly target lifetime: enemies that die before brands, judgments, and Tempest effects convert can waste setup without making the overall rotation hard to recover.
claims.notes: Exact target-lifetime threshold is unknown.

claims.text: Crusader has a low entry floor but a moderately deeper late game because Brand, Judgment, Light's Echo, Serendipity, and capstone timing add optimization around the same visible Tempest core.
claims.notes: Complexity classification from the talent structure.

claims.text: Current PvE advice stacks Holy Cleave to target count, uses several Condemns, preserves Oath Chain with Warrior of Dawn and Argent Blade procs, and saves Titanstrike for execution.
claims.notes: Manually reviewed on 2026-08-06; anecdotal evidence is not treated as a power ranking.
